metadata.archetype_justification: MySQL database with 9 tables, CRUD endpoints for orders/users/returns/inventory, entity lifecycle management (order status machine).

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application uses PHP session-based authentication exclusively. No OAuth2 client credentials flow, no API key mechanism with principal attribution, no mTLS, and no service account support for machine callers. Agents cannot authenticate programmatically.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication mechanism exists. An agent cannot authenticate without simulating a browser session.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key authentication with per-agent principal attribution as an alternative auth path for /api/* endpoints.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement API key authentication with principal attribution for /api/* endpoints.
blocker_remediation.target_state: OAuth2 client credentials flow or API key auth with per-agent principal attribution, logged immutably per request.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: Coarse-grained role-based access with two roles (admin, customer). No fine-grained action-level controls within a role. An admin can perform all admin operations with the same identity.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce read-but-not-delete or query-but-not-mutate within the same role.
findings.recommendation: Introduce action-level permission middleware that evaluates {role, action, resource} tuples.

compensating_controls: Restrict agent identity to customer role
Implement a proxy layer that filters allowed HTTP methods per agent identity

findings.title: No Identity Propagation and Delegation
findings.description: No JWT parsing, no OAuth2 token exchange, no on-behalf-of flow. Session-based auth only. No distinction between agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: System cannot distinguish whose permissions should apply when an agent acts on behalf of a user.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT-based auth with support for both service tokens and delegated tokens.

compensating_controls: Add X-On-Behalf-Of header support with validation

findings.title: Hardcoded Credential Fallbacks
findings.description: Database credentials have hardcoded fallback defaults in application code: getenv('DB_PASS') ?: 'ecommerce_pass'. No Secrets Manager integration. No rotation capability.
findings.gap: Hardcoded credential fallbacks in source code. No secret rotation mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded fallbacks. Integrate AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

compensating_controls: Ensure production always sets DB_PASS env var

findings.title: Mutable Audit Logging
findings.description: Application audit via order_status_history table is in mutable MySQL. VPC Flow Logs configured. No CloudTrail. No immutable log storage.
findings.gap: Audit trail is mutable. No CloudTrail for API-level audit. No immutable storage.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudTrail to CloudFormation. Ship audit logs to immutable storage (S3 with object lock).

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: agent_scope=read-only, immutable audit logging is important but not a deployment blocker for read-only agents.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Read-only agents do not execute write operations, so audit trail immutability is less critical than for write-enabled agents.
compensating_controls: Configure CloudWatch Logs with retention policies

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: Only permanent user deletion exists (DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}). No suspend/disable mechanism. No session invalidation endpoint.
findings.gap: Cannot suspend agent identities without permanent deletion.
findings.recommendation: Add user active/inactive flag checked on every authenticated request. Implement session revocation.

findings.title: No Multi-Step Workflow Compensation
findings.description: Single-request DB transactions exist. Multi-step fulfillment workflow (validate→assign→pick→pack→QC→ship) has no compensation logic. Each step is independent with no saga coordination.
findings.gap: No multi-step workflow compensation. No saga pattern. No undo endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Implement compensation endpoints and consider AWS Step Functions for workflow coordination.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: agent_scope=read-only, read-only agents do not execute write workflows.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Read-only agents do not execute write-enabled multi-step workflows, so compensation capability is relevant for system maturity but not a deployment blocker.
compensating_controls: Implement human approval gates at each transition

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: WAF implements IP whitelisting only, not rate limiting. No requests-per-second throttling, no API Gateway usage plan, no application-level rate limiting middleware.
findings.gap: No rate limiting at any layer. Runaway agent loops from allowed IPs are unprotected.
findings.recommendation: Add WAF rate-based rules (e.g., 1000 requests per 5 minutes per IP) to the existing WebACL.

compensating_controls: WAF IP whitelisting limits attack surface
App Runner auto-scaling provides partial mitigation

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Customer PII stored in single-region RDS. No residency documentation or technical controls preventing cross-region data transmission by agents.
findings.gap: No documented data residency policy. No technical controls preventing data from crossing jurisdictional boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Configure VPC endpoints and network policies for data egress control.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: agent_scope=read-only, data residency is still relevant but lower risk when no data modification occurs.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Read-only agents may still transmit data to LLM endpoints in other regions, creating residency compliance risk.
compensating_controls: Document that production data must remain within deployed region

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: PHP error logging enabled. Exception messages may leak user data. No log scrubbing, no PII masking, no CloudWatch log filters for PII detection.
findings.gap: No PII redaction from application logs. Error messages may contain sensitive data.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured logging with PII field exclusion. Sanitize exception messages. Consider Amazon Macie.

compensating_controls: Restrict log access to operations team
Add CloudWatch Logs filters for PII patterns

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy specification exists. API defined only in PHP source code via regex route matching.
findings.gap: No machine-readable API specification. Agent tool definitions must be manually authored.
findings.recommendation: Generate an OpenAPI 3.0 specification from existing route definitions.

findings.title: Minimal Structured Error Responses
findings.description: JSON error responses with single 'error' field. HTTP status codes set. No error code field, no retryable indicator, no machine-readable error categorization.
findings.gap: Agents cannot programmatically distinguish retriable vs terminal failures.
findings.recommendation: Adopt structured error format: {error_code, message, retryable, details}.

findings.title: No Pagination or Filtering
findings.description: All list endpoints return unbounded result sets. No limit, offset, cursor, or filter parameters on any list endpoint.
findings.gap: Unbounded result sets will exhaust LLM context windows and increase token cost.
findings.recommendation: Add limit and offset query parameters with default limit (50) and maximum (200).

findings.title: Ad-Hoc Input Validation
findings.description: Partial validation exists (empty field checks, inventory checks, prepared statements). No systematic validation framework. Error responses lack field-level detail.
findings.gap: No systematic input validation. Validation errors return generic messages without field identification.
findings.recommendation: Implement systematic request validation with structured error responses.

findings.title: No Timezone Normalization or Freshness Signaling
findings.description: Timestamps exist (created_at, updated_at) but use PHP date() without explicit UTC normalization. No Cache-Control headers, no freshness indicators in responses.
findings.gap: No explicit UTC timezone normalization. No staleness signaling.
findings.recommendation: Normalize to UTC with ISO 8601 format. Add Last-Modified or X-Data-Freshness headers.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No API versioning, no schema versioning, no migration files, no breaking change detection, no contract tests, no changelog.
findings.gap: Agent tool bindings will break silently on any API change.
findings.recommendation: Introduce API versioning (/v1/) and database migrations. Add OpenAPI diff to CI.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry, no trace ID propagation, no structured JSON logging, no correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Cannot debug agent-initiated requests. Cannot correlate log entries for a single request.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON logging with correlation IDs. Integrate AWS X-Ray SDK.

findings.title: No Application-Level Alerting
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms for error rates or latency. RDS Enhanced Monitoring is infrastructure-only. No alerting for API degradation.
findings.gap: Cannot detect when agent-consumed endpoints degrade.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for App Runner 5xx rates, P99 latency, and RDS connection count.

findings.title: IaC Without Review or Drift Detection
findings.description: CloudFormation defines infrastructure. No CI/CD pipeline reviews changes. No drift detection. Manual deploy.sh script.
findings.gap: IaC lacks peer review enforcement and drift monitoring.
findings.recommendation: Add CI/CD pipeline with change set review. Enable AWS Config drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkinsfile, or buildspec. Manual docker-compose deployment only.
findings.gap: No automated API testing or breaking change detection.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated API tests and contract testing.

findings.title: No Automated Rollback
findings.description: Implicit rollback via App Runner image revisions. No automated triggers. No canary deployment. No documented procedure.
findings.gap: No automated rollback triggers on error thresholds.
findings.recommendation: Configure automated rollback on health check failure. Document rollback procedures.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No test files, no test framework, no automated tests of any kind.
findings.gap: No test coverage for agent-consumed APIs. Behavior changes undetectable before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement PHPUnit API tests for critical endpoints. Integrate into CI pipeline.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: Write endpoints use uniqid() with no idempotency key support. POST /api/orders creates new order on every call regardless of duplicate content.
findings.gap: Duplicate operations on retry under write-enabled scope.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency key header support before write-enabled expansion.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to INFO: agent_scope=read-only, read-only agents do not execute write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Read-only agents do not execute write operations, so idempotency is informational only.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: State transitions recorded in order_status_history table only. No webhooks, SNS, EventBridge, Kafka, or CDC pipelines.
findings.gap: Agents cannot react to state changes proactively. Polling is the only option.
findings.recommendation: Add SNS/EventBridge notifications on order status transitions.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation. No X-RateLimit-Remaining or Retry-After headers in API responses.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle based on remaining quota.
findings.recommendation: Include rate limit headers when rate limiting is implemented.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags, no conditional updates. Concurrent writes could corrupt state.
findings.gap: No concurrency controls for concurrent agent instances under write-enabled scope.
findings.recommendation: Add version fields and optimistic locking before write-enabled scope expansion.

findings.title: No Transaction Limits
findings.description: No per-caller transaction limits, no bulk operation caps, no spend thresholds per session.
findings.gap: No business-domain caps on operation scope under write-enabled scope.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-session operation limits before write-enabled expansion.

findings.title: No Formal Data Classification Metadata
findings.description: Passwords properly excluded from API responses. Access differentiation exists (admin/customer). No formal classification metadata (tags, annotations, PII detection).
findings.gap: No formal data classification schema. Aspirational, not a deployment gate.
findings.recommendation: Add field-level sensitivity documentation for agent tool builders.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to INFO: agent_scope=read-only, B1 clear (passwords excluded), B2 clear (role differentiation exists), B3 absent (no formal classification metadata).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Under read-only scope, B1 does not fire as BLOCKER. Passwords are properly excluded from API responses. Only B3 (formal classification metadata) is absent, which is INFO.

b1.reasoning: Passwords excluded from user listing (explicit SELECT), unset from session. Credit cards not stored.

b2.reasoning: Admin/customer role differentiation exists. Customers see only own data.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification tags, no PII annotations, no Macie integration.

findings.title: No Data Quality Monitoring
findings.description: No data quality dashboards, profiling, null rate monitoring, or freshness SLAs. Only database constraints as quality enforcement.
findings.gap: Agents have no way to assess data quality before acting on it.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality metrics as agent usage matures.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No AWS Glue, DataHub, or metadata layer. Schema defined inline in PHP. No data dictionary.
findings.gap: Agent tool builders must inspect source code to understand data.
findings.recommendation: Document the data model (9 tables, relationships, semantic meaning).

findings.title: No Business Outcome Metrics
findings.description: No custom business metrics. Infrastructure metrics only (RDS Enhanced Monitoring, VPC Flow Logs).
findings.gap: Cannot measure whether agent interactions produce good business outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Publish custom CloudWatch metrics for key business events.

evaluations.title: Documented API Interface
evaluations.reason: Application exposes 25+ REST JSON API endpoints under /api/* prefix.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: All API responses are well-structured JSON with Content-Type: application/json.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no operations >30s or long-running workflows detected.

evaluations.title: Scoped Permissions (Least Privilege)
evaluations.reason: Role-based authorization differentiates admin/customer access. IAM policies in CloudFormation are well-scoped.

evaluations.title: Queryable Current State
evaluations.reason: Multiple GET endpoints expose order state, history, products, warehouses.

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — monolith has no external service dependencies.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority specified and not on critical path.

evaluations.title: Draft/Pending State
evaluations.reason: Returns have pending_review status. Orders have multi-step validation workflow with explicit approval at each step.

evaluations.title: Configurable Approval Gates
evaluations.reason: Return approval requires admin action. Order validation requires explicit approval.

evaluations.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
evaluations.reason: docker-compose.yml provides local testing environment with MySQL and auto-generated seed data matching production schema.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names are human-readable: customer_name, total_amount, stock_quantity, tracking_number. No legacy abbreviations.

evaluations.title: Encryption at Rest
evaluations.reason: RDS StorageEncrypted: true. ECR KMS encryption. VPC Flow Logs KMS encrypted. Key rotation enabled.

items.summary: Resolve the machine identity blocker and implement critical safety controls: rate limiting, audit logging, credential management, and PII protection.
Address remaining safety risks and improve API quality for agent integration: versioning, structured errors, pagination, observability, and CI/CD.
Improve operational maturity: rollback automation, test coverage, event emission, temporal metadata, and documentation.
Implement data quality monitoring and advanced observability as agent usage matures.

recommended_actions.action: Implement machine identity authentication (API keys with principal attribution)
recommended_actions.rationale: The single BLOCKER. Without machine identity, agents cannot authenticate. This unlocks AUTH-Q6 (audit attribution) and AUTH-Q7 (identity suspension).

recommended_actions.action: Add WAF rate-based rules to existing WebACL
recommended_actions.rationale: Lowest-effort safety improvement. Prevents agent traffic storms from overwhelming the service.

recommended_actions.action: Integrate AWS Secrets Manager and remove hardcoded credentials
recommended_actions.rationale: Security vulnerability with hardcoded credential fallbacks. Low effort to fix.

recommended_actions.action: Implement structured logging with PII exclusion
recommended_actions.rationale: Addresses both PII compliance risk and observability gap in a single implementation.
Enables automated agent tool generation and API contract testing.

recommended_actions.action: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated testing
recommended_actions.rationale: Foundation for all engineering maturity improvements. Enables automated rollback and contract testing.
